contribution_after.assessment: After revision, the paper is a useful synthesis that brings developmental bioelectricity and synthetic morphology, sensorimotor integration, morphological-freedom and xenofeminist/disability-justice arguments, and a formal four-layer reachable-set framework together into a single disciplined taxonomy. Its formal propositions remain elementary set-theoretic consequences of a conjunctive path definition, and its empirical component remains a descriptive, unadjusted bivariate re-analysis of published Pew aggregate tables (noting the p. 128 title contradiction and comparing enhancement vs. non-bodily regulation gaps) rather than a multivariable test on microdata. The narrowed framing accurately reflects these bounds without overclaiming novelty against capability theory.

summary: Round-2 closure review of 'Ontological Impoverishment: Reachable Bodies and the Freedom to Take Form'. Eleven of twelve referee findings (hydrogen:F1-F3, F5-F12) are closed in the revised manuscript, bibliography, and recorded simulation. hydrogen:F4 is partially closed: the extreme-tails vs. full-sample 'twice as much' / ratio 2.0 comparison is removed, population coverage and adjacent religiosity steps are added, and all survey claims are narrowed to unadjusted descriptive bivariate comparisons, but multivariable regression on Pew ATP Wave 99 respondent-level microdata remains unexecuted because Pew gates dataset downloads behind an account login. No new problems were introduced, all 44 prose/table quantities are bound in claims.yaml with 0 unbound numbers, all 42 source claims in claims.yaml match the verified round-1 verdicts, all 9 added references verify against Crossref/OpenAlex/Europe PMC/OpenLibrary, and all 22 rendered PDF pages pass visual inspection. The revised paper stands as a useful synthesis.

paper/PAPER.md lines 9, 17, and 53-62 (diff.patch lines 649, 658-659, 696-710) unify the informal and formal definitions by defining F as admissible alternative arrangements (S', I') that satisfy both comparable total cost at t and justification of restrictions and burdens to everyone affected.
